categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in IC packaging and testing services, including IC packaging, IC testing, module processing, wafer-level packaging, and wafer-level testing. It also offers advanced packaging technologies such as flip chip, fan-out panel level packaging, system-in-package (SiP), and 3D IC packaging. The business segments cover a broad range of semiconductor packaging and testing solutions catering to memory, logic, and system products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced semiconductor packaging methods such as Through Silicon Via (TSV) with via-last and via-middle techniques, high bandwidth memory (HBM) packaging, 2.5D and 3D packaging, fan-out wafer and panel level packaging (FOWLP/FOPLP), flip chip packaging, copper pillar bumping, embedded antenna packaging (AiP), and system-in-package (SiP). The company emphasizes high precision manufacturing, automated optical inspection, and integration of heterogeneous chips to meet high-performance computing and AI application demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are semiconductor manufacturers focusing on memory (DRAM, NAND flash), logic ICs, and system products used in AI, high-performance computing, cloud servers, automotive electronics, mobile devices, and consumer electronics. Major markets include AI, data centers, 5G communications, automotive electronics, and wearable devices. The company serves global semiconductor supply chains with a focus on strategic alliances with leading IDM and fabless companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with significant sales to international markets including Japan, Singapore, the Americas, Europe, and China (including Hong Kong and Macau). Export sales constitute over 80% of revenue, with key markets in Asia-Pacific, North America, and Europe. The company also has subsidiaries and investments in China and Singapore to support regional operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the downstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, specializing in outsourced semiconductor assembly and testing (OSAT). It provides comprehensive post-wafer manufacturing services including packaging, testing, module assembly, and final testing, bridging wafer fabrication and end-product assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on advancing packaging technologies such as TSV, HBM, fan-out panel level packaging, and heterogeneous integration. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop new packaging solutions for AI, HPC, 5G, automotive, and wearable applications. Emphasis is placed on improving production yield, shortening development cycles, and cost-effective solutions. Digital transformation, automation, and sustainability are also key R&D themes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service fees for IC packaging, testing, and module assembly. The company offers turnkey solutions integrating multiple packaging and testing services, generating income from volume-based manufacturing contracts with semiconductor customers. Revenue is derived from both domestic and international sales of these services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading global OSAT provider with comprehensive packaging and testing capabilities. It competes with other major semiconductor packaging and testing firms such as ASE Technology, JCET, and SPIL. Its competitive advantages include advanced technology leadership, high production yield, cost efficiency, and strong strategic alliances with major semiconductor manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$73.3 billion, representing a 4.08% increase over the previous year. Net income attributable to shareholders was about NT$6.78 billion, with an EPS of NT$9.09. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding advanced packaging capacity and diversified product offerings. It has a strong asset base exceeding NT$109 billion and continues to invest in capital expenditures and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive one-stop advanced packaging and testing services, integrating cutting-edge technologies like TSV, fan-out packaging, and heterogeneous integration to meet evolving semiconductor demands. It differentiates itself through high production yields, rapid turnaround times, cost-effective solutions, and strong customer partnerships. Its commitment to innovation, quality, and sustainability further enhances its competitive positioning.
